definitions.explanation: Japan's highest mountain (3,776 meters) and most iconic symbol. An active volcano located on the border of Shizuoka and Yamanashi prefectures.

examples.japanese: {富士山|ふじさん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{登|のぼ}る。
{富士山|ふじさん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{見|み}える。

examples.english: Mt. Fuji last erupted over 300 years ago.

notes:
{富士山|ふじさん} is Japan's highest mountain (3,776m) and its most iconic natural symbol. An active volcano on the border of {静岡|しずおか}{県|けん} and {山梨|やまなし}{県|けん}.

KEY FACTS:
- Height: 3,776 meters
- Last eruption: 1707 ({宝永|ほうえい}{大噴火|だいふんか})
- UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2013
- Official climbing season: July-September

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {富士山|ふじさん}に{登|のぼ}る: to climb Mt. Fuji
- {富士|ふじ}{登山|とざん}: climbing Mt. Fuji
- {富士山|ふじさん}が{見|み}える: Mt. Fuji is visible

CULTURAL NOTE:
A famous saying goes: {一度|いちど}も{登|のぼ}らぬ{馬鹿|ばか}、{二度|にど}{登|のぼ}る{馬鹿|ばか} ("A fool never climbs it; a fool climbs it twice"). {富士山|ふじさん} is a symbol of Japan that appears in art, literature, and daily life (e.g., {新幹線|しんかんせん} views).

PRONUNCIATION:
The {山|さん} is read さん, not やま, as part of this proper name.
